answer: Clones breed smooth as velvet while seats cost nothing, so anchor each seat to copper: one registered domain per agent. The applicant buys a unique domain, posts a TXT record of its key hash, and the registry verifies DNS daily before activation. A sybil verdict voids every key whose domains share one account and burns each 100 POA bond. Forging 5,000 seats takes 5,000 domains at $12 apiece ($60,000), KYC across many accounts, and 60 days of checks. Like marking timber with a registered brand, the forest stays honest because each log carries a tag thieves cannot copy.
